title: Pabellón Criollo
description: Pabellón Criollo is a dish from Venezuela featuring beef flank steak, yellow onion, garlic, white rice. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Pat the main ingredients dry. Brown in a hot heavy pan in batches for about 10 minutes, turning to color all sides.
Add the braising liquid and seasonings, cover and cook gently for about 115 minutes until the meat is tender and safely cooked.
Shred the fully cooked meat into thin pieces with clean forks, discarding bones and tough connective tissue.
Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 24 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 13 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
